ActionPeriod.name: Action Period
ActionPeriod.definition: Period during which the specified option, or all options of the event, remains valid, eg, offer period.

CompulsoryPurchasePeriod.name: Compulsory Purchase Period
CompulsoryPurchasePeriod.definition: Period during a take-over where any outstanding equity must be purchased by the take-over company.

InterestPeriod.name: Interest Period
InterestPeriod.definition: Period during which the interest rate has been applied.

BlockingPeriod.name: Blocking Period
BlockingPeriod.definition: Period during which the security is blocked.

PriceCalculationPeriod.name: Price Calculation Period
PriceCalculationPeriod.definition: Period during which the price of a security is determined.
